text:
Anya: dropping a tiny thread for the compact playground chat UI: live streaming, token peek pill, single-stop FAB + regen in overflow. quick takes?
Matt: looks clean. q: do we update the token peek live or only on stop?
Anya: live but subtle. no flashy motion.
Sophia: a11y caution: screen readers will read every change. only expose final totals via aria-live.
DesignBot: rec: role=status for final token count, aria-atomic=true when posting final, and keyboard focus for breakdown.
Jess: can we surface a small "~+N" regen estimate by default off, opt-in via prompt library prefs?
Ryan: compact controls: primary icon-only Stop, overflow for Regenerate/Retry. mobile long-press to reveal.
Matt: engineering note: batch updates every ~250ms to avoid UI churn; debounce streaming increments.
Anya: copy drafts: Stop tooltip: "Stop generation — keeps partial reply." Regenerate tooltip: "Regenerate reply" Toast: "Regenerating (~+45 tokens)"
Jess: for high-cost regens (>500 tokens) require confirm modal; otherwise toast. capture telemetry.
Anya: next: iterate pill positions (corner vs inline), finalize microcopy, and deliver a compact toolbar spec. I'll attach mocks in the design doc.
